difficulty_reason: H3: the proof adapts infinite-fern geometry to the support of an arithmetic patched module through a locally analytic Jacquet sheaf. The author supplies the all-refinement nonvanishing argument, then uses benign-point smoothness, eigenvariety/trianguline component comparison and tangent-space spanning to show each smooth closure component is locally an ambient component. The rigid-to-algebraic p-torsion-free passage completes the support theorem. This is a different nonroutine geometric mechanism from the supercuspidal type-capture family.
